jabrutMedia.resultsDescription: A product-provided illustration comparing the appearance and texture of the skin before use and after 30 days. Results may vary from person to person and are not guaranteed.
jabrutMedia.usageDescription: Cleanse the skin with warm water, then apply a small amount to the fingertips. Gently massage the face and neck using upward circular motions, and repeat twice daily as directed on the package. Stop use if irritation occurs.
jabrutMedia.packageDescription: A clear view of the 50 ml Al Jabrut Assaoudi tube and its retail box. Read the ingredients and instructions printed on the package before first use.

capsicumMedia.productTitle: Capsicum cream for muscle and joint comfort
capsicumMedia.productDescription: A warming capsicum cream for external use on areas such as the knees, neck, and shoulders. Check the original package for size, ingredients, and directions before first use.
capsicumMedia.usageDescription:
1. Cleanse and dry the area.
2. Apply a thin layer.
3. Massage gently. The warming effect may last about 6 to 12 hours.
4. Wash your hands well afterwards.
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes.
capsicumMedia.beforeAfterDescription: A product illustration comparing discomfort before use with a more relaxed appearance afterwards. Results vary from person to person and are not guaranteed.
capsicumMedia.areasDescription: The cream is intended for external application to common areas of muscle and joint discomfort, including the back, knees, neck, and shoulders. Follow the original package instructions and stop use if irritation occurs.

mathGameMedia.contentsDescription: An educational set featuring a blue number board, assorted operation and math-problem cards, plus pieces and rings for organizing play and learning.
mathGameMedia.usageDescription: Turn over an operation card and a main card, then find the matching number on the blue board. Solve the problem, choose the answer, and check it with the other players.
mathGameMedia.individualDescription: Children can use the cards and board to practise numbers and mathematical operations in a hands-on, enjoyable way, with adult guidance when needed.
mathGameMedia.groupDescription: Suitable for two or more children. Players take turns solving cards and comparing answers, encouraging participation, concentration, and learning together.

bootyGainerMedia.productDescription: A dietary supplement in a white bottle with a magenta label reading Booty Gainer Pro Series. The label shows 60 capsules for a 30-day supply, and states: helps grow glutes, assists rounder shape, and helps lift and firm. Capsules shown beside the bottle appear magenta/pink.
bootyGainerMedia.premiumDescription: The bottle is shown on a gold stand with a red rose and a Hero Premium badge. The pack carries the same series name and the 60-capsule, 30-day supply details printed on the label.
bootyGainerMedia.lifestyleDescription: The product photographed in a gym beside training shoes and a water bottle. The label mentions support for glute appearance alongside an active training lifestyle.
bootyGainerMedia.resultsDescription: A marketing image showing the Booty Gainer Pro Series bottle with sportswear photos. These are promotional images; results vary from person to person and are not guaranteed.
bootyGainerMedia.usageDescription: According to the usage guide in the image: 2 capsules daily. Timing: take with meals (breakfast or lunch), and a second capsule before sleep. Hydration: drink plenty of water (8 glasses minimum). Training: glute and leg routine. The bottle contains 60 capsules for 30 days.

melaxinMedia.productTitle: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot — White Rice Ampoule
melaxinMedia.productDescription: Dr.Melaxin Peel Shot Exfoliating White Rice Ampoule with a gold/white dropper and a clear liquid. The label lists rice as the key ingredient, plus rice bran water and niacinamide, and mentions brightening care, mild peeling, and suitability for all skin types.
melaxinMedia.salonDescription: Three dropper bottles of the same product shown together. The labels read Peel Shot Exfoliating White Rice Ampoule, with rice as the key ingredient. The printed sizes differ between the bottles shown.
melaxinMedia.usageTitle: How to apply with the dropper
melaxinMedia.usageDescription: The photo shows applying the ampoule with a dropper to the face. Follow the original bottle instructions before first use.
melaxinMedia.beforeAfterDescription: A product comparison marked Before and After. The label mentions brightening care and mild peeling for all skin types. Results are personal and may vary; the image is not a guarantee.

eelhoeMedia.productDescription: Two amber glass spray bottles with black pumps and a dark-green and gold box. The pack reads eelhoe Hair Darkening Spray. Arabic on the bottles and box: hair coloring and darkening spray. Printed claim: revealing the secret of hair full of vitality and shine. Size shown: 120ml / 4.05 fl.oz. Text at the bottom of the image: for cosmetic use only.
eelhoeMedia.premiumDescription: A close view of both bottles and the box on a marble stand with a gold rim. Same name eelhoe Hair Darkening Spray, the same Arabic wording for hair coloring and darkening spray, and the vitality-and-shine line. Size shown: 120ml / 4.05 fl.oz. The box shows two circles: gray strands and darker hair, plus a printed dark hair strand on the side.
eelhoeMedia.lifestyleDescription: The product shown with a woman in an elegant bathroom, holding an eelhoe bottle. The two bottles and box keep the original name eelhoe Hair Darkening Spray, the Arabic hair-darkening wording, the vitality-and-shine line, and the 120 ml / 4.05 fl.oz size.
eelhoeMedia.usageDescription: The photo shows spraying from the original bottle in front of a mirror. The label reads eelhoe Hair Darkening Spray, the Arabic hair coloring and darkening spray wording, the vitality-and-shine line, and 120ml / 4.05 fl.oz. Follow the pack instructions before use. For cosmetic use only, as printed on the product.
eelhoeMedia.beforeAfterDescription: A comparison marked Before and After. The Before side shows gray strands; the After side shows a darker look. Original bottles and box appear with the same name and size. Text at the bottom: Note: results may vary. This is a cosmetic illustration only; results differ and are not guaranteed.
eelhoeMedia.instagramDescription: A clear view of the two amber bottles and green box on marble. Pack wording unchanged: eelhoe Hair Darkening Spray, Arabic hair coloring and darkening spray, the vitality-and-shine line, and 120ml / 4.05 fl.oz.
eelhoeMedia.tiktokDescription: A tall frame showing the product with a woman beside it. Bottles and box keep the original name, logo, and wording: eelhoe Hair Darkening Spray, Arabic hair coloring and darkening spray, the vitality-and-shine line, and 120 ml.

emsFootMedia.productDescription: A thin, light black mat with silver lines tracing the feet and sole points, printed EMS FOOTMASSAGER. A round digital controller sits in the middle. Foldable and easy to carry and store, for home, office, and travel.
emsFootMedia.lifestyleDescription: After a long day of standing or walking, sit on the sofa with a book or a cup of tea and rest your feet on the mat. Gentle EMS pulses leave your feet feeling relaxed and refreshed, without a trip to a massage center.
emsFootMedia.controllerDescription: A sleek controller with a glowing blue ring and a digital display showing the intensity level. One button to switch on and two to raise or lower the intensity and change the mode. Rechargeable, so there are no cables during the session.
emsFootMedia.usageDescription:
1. Place the mat on a flat floor and sit comfortably.
2. Put your bare feet on the foot outlines.
3. Press the power button and start at the lowest intensity, then raise it gradually.
4. A session of about 15 minutes is enough.
Warning: do not use with a pacemaker, during pregnancy, or with epilepsy, heart conditions, or open wounds on the feet.

perfumeTrioMedia.productDescription: The three perfumes in front of their original boxes: La vita sbela in golden amber with a shimmering silver box, Mi WAY Fancy City in soft pink with a round bottle and pink box, and IDEAL in a square bottle with a rose-gold cap and white box. Three different looks in one set.
perfumeTrioMedia.collectionDescription: The full set on a marble table with roses, in a calm, refined setting. A scent for every mood and occasion: work, evenings, and everyday looks. Each perfume comes in its own elegant box, making the set a special gift.
perfumeTrioMedia.laVitaDescription: A clear bottle in warm golden amber with a gold spray cap that gives a fine, even mist. A sweet, feminine scent for evening looks and special occasions.
perfumeTrioMedia.notesDescription: La vita sbela surrounded by ingredients that capture its character: rose petals and jasmine for a floral heart; peach, mandarin, blackcurrant, and pink pepper for a fresh opening; and vanilla and sandalwood for a warm base. An illustrative image that reflects the spirit of the scent.
perfumeTrioMedia.lifestyleTitle: Your final touch before heading out
perfumeTrioMedia.lifestyleDescription: One spray in front of the mirror completes your look. Spray on pulse points such as the wrists, neck, and behind the ears from about 15 cm, without rubbing, so it lasts longer.

osweiMedia.productDescription: Everything in one set: an elegant white storage holder with a rose-gold rim and a side window to see the remaining pads, a long white cleaning handle, and a set of replaceable blue sponge pads. A modern design that suits any bathroom.
osweiMedia.lifestyleDescription: The sponge pad reaches every corner of the bowl and under the rim, while the long handle keeps your hand away from the mess. The stylish holder stores fresh pads and looks good in the bathroom, instead of an old dirty brush.
osweiMedia.usageDescription:
1. Pick a new pad: take a fresh cleaning pad from the holder.
2. Fit the pad: attach it to the handle head.
3. Clean: clean the toilet as usual.
4. Dispose: press the button to drop the used pad into the trash without touching it.
osweiMedia.beforeAfterDescription: An illustrative comparison: before, a stained bowl and a dirty traditional brush; after, a clean, shiny bowl with a fresh pad every time. Results depend on the toilet's condition and the cleaner used.

batterySwitchMedia.productDescription: A compact unit that mounts directly on the car battery terminal, between the terminal and the cable. Cut or restore the battery power completely at the press of a button, with no tools and no unbolting cables. A practical way to protect the battery from draining when the car is parked for a long time.
batterySwitchMedia.remotesDescription: Comes with two sleek remotes on key rings: ON restores power and OFF cuts it. Keep one with your car keys and the other as a spare or for another family member.
batterySwitchMedia.installationDescription: The switch fits on the battery terminal in minutes, and from then on you control it from outside the car with the remote. Installation by a qualified technician is recommended; check compatibility with your car's battery and electrical system.
batterySwitchMedia.remoteControlTitle: Remote control, from anywhere in the garage
batterySwitchMedia.remoteControlDescription:
The problem: you leave your car in a dark garage or for a long time, worried the battery will drain or someone will try to start it, and opening the hood to unbolt the cable is a hassle.
The solution: the unit sits hidden in the engine bay, barely visible. From outside the car, press OFF on the remote to cut the power, then ON when you return. No tools, no mess, no opening the hood, just one press.

eyeLiftMedia.productTitle: Harvey Ross Instant Eye Lift cream
eyeLiftMedia.productDescription: The silver and black pump bottle with its original black box. The box reads INSTANT EYE LIFT: long term water locking, moisturize the eye area, and reduce dark circles under the eyes. For a brighter, fresher-looking eye area.
eyeLiftMedia.textureDescription: A smooth, soft white cream with a light texture that spreads easily over the delicate skin around the eyes. A small amount on the fingertip is enough for each eye, and the pump dispenses it without waste.
eyeLiftMedia.usageDescription:
1. Place a pea-sized amount in small dots under the eye.
2. Pat gently with your fingertips, from the inner to the outer corner, until spread.
3. Final step: let it dry before applying makeup.
Follow the steps for best results, and avoid direct contact with the eyes.
eyeLiftMedia.beforeAfterDescription: An illustrative comparison: the before side shows a tired eye with dark circles, and the after side shows a brighter, firmer-looking eye area. Cosmetic illustration only; the effect is temporary, results vary, and it is not a medical treatment.

hairConcealerMedia.productDescription: The white and black bottle with its sleek black box. The pack reads Hair concealer – FULLER HAIR LOOK. According to the package, it lasts 3 to 7 days and is waterproof and sweatproof. A cosmetic spray that instantly covers thinning areas.
hairConcealerMedia.lifestyleDescription: One spray for everyone: it gives men a fuller look at the hairline and crown, and helps women cover a wide parting and thinning spots, for a confident, polished look every day and on special occasions.
hairConcealerMedia.usageDescription: On clean, dry hair, shake the bottle and spray from a short distance directly onto the scalp and thinning areas. It blends with existing hair to fill gaps and add instant density. Let it dry for a moment, then style as usual. Avoid contact with the eyes.
hairConcealerMedia.beforeAfterDescription: An illustrative comparison: the top row (before) shows a receding hairline on the man and a visible parting on the woman; the bottom row (after) shows fuller-looking hair with the gaps covered. Cosmetic illustration only; the product covers thinning areas and does not treat hair loss, and results vary.

alAsmadMedia.productDescription: The original pack of Al-Asmad Alharmain Black Kohl cooled with Zamzam water and rose water. Shows the black box, glass vial with engraved gold cap, and traditional applicator wand with carved brass handle.
alAsmadMedia.mainDescription: Black kohl with an elegant design, a classic beauty touch for a distinctive look.
alAsmadMedia.lifestyleDescription: A touch of black kohl to enhance eye beauty and complement the look.
alAsmadMedia.usageDescription: A simple application method to add an elegant touch to eye makeup.
alAsmadMedia.premiumDescription: An elegant oriental design combining simplicity and luxury.
alAsmadMedia.closeupDescription: Product details clearly displayed in a professional shot designed for elegance lovers.
alAsmadMedia.commercialDescription: An elegant choice for lovers of black kohl and classic Arab looks.

deepCeraMedia.productDescription: Clean studio showcase of the authentic DEEP CERA VITAMIN illuminating Serum bottle and carton box (30ml / 1.01 FL.OZ.), clearly displaying printed ingredients: Acerola, Niacinamide, Tranexamic Acid, and Ceramide.
deepCeraMedia.beautyDescription: Close-up beauty portrait highlighting a radiant, dewy complexion alongside the DEEP CERA serum, illustrating a fresh and luminous skin appearance.
deepCeraMedia.ingredientsTitle: Key Ingredients Featured on the Packaging
deepCeraMedia.ingredientsDescription: An organized flat lay displaying the DEEP CERA bottle and box alongside its key printed ingredients: fresh Acerola, pure Niacinamide, Tranexamic Acid, and Ceramide structure.
deepCeraMedia.textureDescription: Macro detail of the glass pipette dispensing a single golden drop over a reflective glass shelf, highlighting the fluid, lightweight consistency and clean application.
deepCeraMedia.routineDescription: Step-by-step application in a morning or evening routine, using the dropper to gently apply serum droplets onto clean skin for effortless absorption.
deepCeraMedia.glowRoutineDescription: Illustrative routine visual showcasing enhanced skin luminosity paired with the authentic DEEP CERA bottle and packaging designed for everyday care.
deepCeraMedia.luxuryDescription: Commercial luxury presentation of the serum bottle and box set against draped golden satin silk with delicate droplets, reflecting refined packaging aesthetics.
deepCeraMedia.freshDescription: Vibrant flat lay surrounding the serum with sliced oranges, ripe acerola cherries, and green leaves, capturing the fresh vitamin-rich botanical theme.
